figures.title: TIPS Procedure and Patency
figures.alt: Diagram showing the Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt (TIPS) procedure, from jugular access to right-to-right puncture, covered graft placement, and duplex ultrasound confirming patency.
figures.caption: Illustrates TIPS procedure with jugular access, covered graft, and duplex ultrasound for patency. Image: R. Torrance Andrews, MD, CC BY 1.0, Wikimedia Commons.
